tasks.title: Develop Catalog Management Functionality
tasks.description: Implement creation and update capabilities for products and customer accounts for store owners and sales personnel.

tasks.title: Develop Customer Browse and Cart Functionality
tasks.description: Implement product browsing, shopping cart management, and cart validation for customers.

tasks.title: Develop Order Processing Functionality
tasks.description: Implement authentication check for order placement, order creation, and reference display.

acceptance_criteria.given: a store owner or sales personnel is authenticated
acceptance_criteria.when: they provide details for a new product
acceptance_criteria.then: the system saves the new product to the catalog

source.quote: Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts.

acceptance_criteria.given: a store owner or sales personnel is authenticated
acceptance_criteria.when: they provide details for a new customer account

source.quote: Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts.

acceptance_criteria.given: an available product exists in the system
acceptance_criteria.then: the product is listed for the customer to view

source.quote: customers should be able to browse the available products

acceptance_criteria.when: they add an available product to the cart
acceptance_criteria.then: the item appears in the shopping cart

source.quote: Customers can add available products to the cart

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer has items in their cart
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer successfully submits the order
acceptance_criteria.then: a single order containing selected items is created

source.quote: A successful submission creates one order containing the selected items and quantities

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer is not signed in
acceptance_criteria.then: they are able to browse products

source.quote: Customers may browse without signing in

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer is not signed in
acceptance_criteria.when: they attempt to place an order
acceptance_criteria.then: the system redirects or prompts the customer to sign in

source.quote: must sign in before placing an order.

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer has an item in the cart
acceptance_criteria.when: they update the quantity to a positive whole number
acceptance_criteria.then: the cart updates to the new quantity

source.quote: change quantities to positive whole numbers

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer has items in the cart
acceptance_criteria.when: they select an item to remove
acceptance_criteria.then: the item is removed from the cart

source.quote: remove items.

acceptance_criteria.given: a store owner or sales personnel is authenticated
acceptance_criteria.then: the system updates the product information

source.quote: Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts.

acceptance_criteria.given: a store owner or sales personnel is authenticated
acceptance_criteria.when: they edit an existing customer account
acceptance_criteria.then: the system updates the account information

source.quote: Store owners and sales personnel can create and update products and customer accounts.

acceptance_criteria.then: the system displays the unique order reference

source.quote: A successful submission creates one order... and displays its reference.

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer has an empty cart
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer attempts to submit the cart
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the submission and no order is created

source.quote: An empty cart cannot be submitted.
